Variants.Content: Sunspear is located in Dorne. The main city of the Martell family is located between the Greenblood River Delta and the Dorne Sea. Palaces, waterways, ports and shadow cities together constitute its urban structure; it not only controls the political name of Dorne, but also must rely on the cooperation of its inland mountain and desert vassals.

Entry Sunspear Local families also rely on wells, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and travel to avoid the hot sun; if any road, well, or dock fails, the cost falls first on them.
Entry Sunspear They also recognize Dornish accents, laws and credentials; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar or horse's hoof.

Entry Sunspear If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

The craftsmen of Sunspear left behind their craftsmanship with ship-repairing wood, canvas, salt, fish catches, and stones to withstand the sea wind, while the clergy used the Seven Gods, the legacy of Rhoynar, and the common memories of different bloodlines under the prince's rule to explain life and death. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Sunspear They care about wells and springs, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and routes to avoid the scorching sun. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
